1.1: Hakkol chayyavin bariyya, chutz mecheresh, shote vekatan, vetumtum, veanderoginos, venashim, vaavadim sheenam meshuchrarim, hachigger, vehassuma, vehachole, vehazzaken, umi sheeno yachol laalot beraglav. ezehu katan, kol sheeno yachol lirkov al ketefav shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, divre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, kol sheeno yachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot mirushalayim lehar habbayit, shenneemar (Shemot 23) shalosh regalim:
1.2: Bet shammay omrim, hariyya shete chesef, vachagiga maa chesef. uvet hillel omrim, hariyya maa chesef, vachagiga shete chasef:
1.3: Olot bammoed baot min hachullin, vehashshelamim min hammaaser. yom tov rishon shel pesach, bet shammay omrim, min hachullin, uvet hillel omrim, min hammaaser:
1.4: Yisrael yotzin yede chovatan bindarim unedavot uvemasar behema, vehakkohanim bachattaot uvaashamot uvabbechor uvechaze vashok, aval lo vaofot velo vammenachot:
1.5: Mi sheyyesh lo ochlim merubbim unechasim muatim, mevi shelamim merubbim veolot muatot. nechasim merubbim veochlin muatin, mevi olot merubbot ushelamim muatin. ze vaze muat, al ze neemar, maa chesef ushete chasef. ze vaze merubbim, al ze neemar (Devarim 16) ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach:
1.6: Mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag, chogeg et kol haregel veyom tov haacharon shel chag. avar haregel velo chag, eno chayyav beacharayuto. al ze neemar (Kohelet 1) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon, vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot:
1.7: Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer, ezehu meuvvat sheeno yachol litkon, ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer. im tomar begonev vegozel, yachol hu lehachaziro vitakken. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer, en korin meuvvat ella lemi shehaya metukkan battechilla venitavvet, veeze, ze talmid chacham happoresh min hattora:
1.8: Hetter nedarim porchin baavir, veen lahem al ma sheyyismochu. hilchot shabbat, chagigot vehammeilot, hare hem kahararim hatteluyin besaara, shehen mikra muat vahalachot merubbot. haddinin vehaavodot, hattohorot vehattumot vaarayot, yesh lahen al ma sheyyismochu. hen hen gufe tora:

2.1: En dorshin baarayot bishlosha. velo vemaase vereshit bishnayim. velo vammerkava beyachid, ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato. kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim, rauy lo keillu lo ba laolam, ma lemala, ma lematta, ma lefanim, uma leachor. vechol shello chas al kevod kono, rauy lo shello ba laolam:
2.2: Yose ben yoezer omer shello lismoch, yose ben yochanan omer lismoch. yehoshua ben perachya omer shello lismoch, nittay haarbeli omer lismoch. yehuda ben tabbay omer shello lismoch, shimon ben shatach omer lismoch. shemaya omer lismoch. avtalyon omer shello lismoch. hillel umenachem lo nechleku. yatza menachem, nichnas shammay. shammay omer shello lismoch, hillel omer lismoch. harishonim hayu nesiim, usheniyyim lahem av bet din:
2.3: Bet shammay omrim, meviin shelamim veen somchin alehem, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim, meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehem:
2.4: Atzeret shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, bet shammay omrim, yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. uvet hillel omrim, en yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. umodim sheim chal lihyot beshabbat, sheyyom tevoach achar hashshabbat. veen kohen gadol mitlabbesh bechelav, umuttarin behesped uvetaanit, shello lekayyem divre haomrin atzeret achar hashshabbat:
2.5: Notlin layyadayim lechullin ulemaaser velitruma. ulekodesh, matbilin. ulechattat, im nitmeu yadav, nitma gufo:
2.6: Hattovel lechullin vehuchzak lechullin, asur lemaaser. taval lemaaser vehuchzak lemaaser, asur litruma. taval litruma, vehuchzak litruma, asur lekodesh. taval lekodesh vehuchzak lekodesh, asur lechattat. taval lechamur, muttar lekal. taval velo huchzak, keillu lo taval:
2.7: Bigde am haaretz midras lapperushin. bigde ferushin midras leochle teruma. bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh. bigde kodesh midras lechattat. yosef ben yoezer haya chasid shebbakkehunna, vehayta mitpachto midras lakkodesh. yochanan ben gudgeda haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh kol yamav, vehayta mitpachto midras lachattat:

3.1: Chomer bakkodesh mibbatteruma, shemmatbilin kelim betoch kelim latteruma, aval lo lakkodesh. achorayim vetoch uvet hatztzevita batteruma, aval lo vakkodesh. hannose et hammidras nose et hatteruma, aval lo et hakkodesh. bigde ochle teruma, midras lakkodesh. lo chemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma, shebbakkodesh mattir umenaggev umatbil veachar kach kosher, uvatteruma kosher veachar kach matbil:
3.2: Kelim hannigmarin betohora, tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. harvii bakkodesh pasul, vehashshelishi batteruma. uvatteruma, im nitmet achat miyyadav, chavertah tehora. uvakkodesh, matbil shetehen, shehayyad metamma et chavertah bakkodesh, aval lo batteruma:
3.3: Ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot batteruma, aval lo bakkodesh. haonen umechussar kippurim tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma:
3.4: Chomer batteruma, shebbihuda neemanim al tohorat yayin veshemen kol yemot hashshana, uvishat haggittot vehabbaddim af al hatteruma. avru haggittot vehabbaddim veheviu lo chavit shel yayin shel teruma, lo yekabbelenna mimmennu, aval mannichah laggat habbaa. veim amar lo, hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh, neeman. kadde yayin vechadde shemen hamedummaot, neemanin alehem bishat haggittot vehabbaddim, vekodem laggittot shivim yom:
3.5: Min hammodiit velifnim, neemanin al kele cheres. min hammodiit velachutz, en neemanim. ketzad, hakkaddar shehu mocher hakkederot, nichnas lifnim min hammodiit, hu hakkaddar vehen hakkederot vehen hallokchim, neeman. yatza, eno neeman:
3.6: Haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit, vechen haggannavim shehecheziru et hakkelim, neemanin lomar, lo naganu. uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh, uvishat haregel af al hatteruma:
3.7: Happoteach et chavito, vehammatchil beissato al gav haregel, rabbi yehuda omer, yigmor. vachachamim omrim, lo yigmor. mishsheavar haregel, hayu maavirin al tohorat azara. avar haregel beyom shishshi, lo hayu maavirin, mippene chevod hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo veyom chamishi, sheen hakkohanim penuyin:
3.8: Ketzad maavirim al tohorat azara. matbilin et hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, veomrin lahem, hizzaharu shello tiggeu bashshulchan uvammenora utetammeuhu. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, yesh lahem sheniyyim ushelishim, sheim nitmeu harishonim, yaviu sheniyyim tachtehen. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, teunin tevila, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet, mippene shehen kakkarka, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mippene shehen metzuppin:
